from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import requests,json,hashlib,shutil,importlib.util
out=Path('reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_source_qualification_v1')
url='https://home.treasury.gov/system/files/136/SourcesUsesJul2023.pdf'
rec={'url':url,'role':'唯一支持原件：同原公告链接的资金来源与用途表，解释借款/现金/财政流与其他项目的口径','attempts':[]}
for attempt in range(1,3):
 r=None;a={'attempt':attempt,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()}
 try:
  r=requests.get(url,timeout=(15,35),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'})
  a['http_status']=r.status_code;r.raise_for_status()
  assert r.content.startswith(b'%PDF')
  p=out/'sources/20230731_资金来源与用途原表.pdf';p.write_bytes(r.content)
  a['status']='SAVED_ORIGINAL';rec['attempts'].append(a)
  rec.update(status='SAVED_ORIGINAL',path=str(p).replace('\\','/'),bytes=len(r.content),sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest());break
 except Exception as e:
  a.update(status='FAILED',error=str(e)[:1000]);rec['attempts'].append(a)
  if r is not None and r.status_code in (403,429):break
rec.setdefault('status','FAILED_AFTER_REGISTERED_ATTEMPTS')
(out/'support_source_receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(rec,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps(rec,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print('可用渲染：pdftoppm=',shutil.which('pdftoppm'),'pdfplumber=',bool(importlib.util.find_spec('pdfplumber')),'pypdfium2=',bool(importlib.util.find_spec('pypdfium2')),'fitz=',bool(importlib.util.find_spec('fitz')))
